reason: The cited evidence (E2, E4) shows that a 2D (MoWNbTaV)0.2S2 coating, not a bulk alloy addition, provides low friction and wear via tribocatalysis on steel, but no evidence supports forming such a structure by adding MoWNbTaV to Ti6Al4V, nor any effect on hardness or property retention.
premises: Adding MoWNbTaV to Ti6Al4V forms a 2D HEA nanoflake structure
This structure provides tribocatalytic activity and shear-induced energy dissipation
These mechanisms improve hardness and wear resistance
The improvement occurs under high contact pressures and ambient conditions
The addition does not sacrifice existing beneficial properties of Ti6Al4V
